name: Michael E. Gates
quote: Californians voted for Prop. 36 overwhelmingly to restore accountability for repeat theft and drug offenses. I will fully enforce it
positionText: Supports enforcing Proposition 36 for repeat theft and drug offenses.

name: Malia M. Cohen
quote: She is running for re-election to ensure taxpayer dollars are managed with transparency, accountability, and fairness.
positionText: Supports transparent and accountable management of state finances.

name: Herb W Morgan
quote: I will deliver for the people by placing all expenditures in an easy-to-use online database with transaction-level detail and near real-time reporting, so every Californian can see exactly how public funds are used.
positionText: Proposes a public database showing state spending at the transaction level.

name: Ben Allen
quote: As Insurance Commissioner, I’ll increase competition to bring down costs, protect consumers who are unfairly dropped, make insurers accountable and the process transparent, and expedite rebuilding.
positionText: Supports more insurance competition, consumer protections, and faster rebuilding.

name: Jane Kim
quote: I’ll make claims fast and fair, cap excessive profits, and crack down on illegal price-fixing.
positionText: Supports insurance profit limits and enforcement against price-fixing.

name: Jane Kim
quote: I’ll ensure our premiums are invested into making our communities safer through a public Disaster Insurance for All program.
positionText: Proposes a public Disaster Insurance for All program.

name: Jane Kim
quote: And I’ll fight for guaranteed healthcare for every California child.
positionText: Supports guaranteed healthcare for every child in California.

name: Jennifer Hawks
quote: I will advocate for responsible investing, greater accountability, and honest stewardship of the public’s money.
positionText: Supports responsible public investment and greater financial accountability.

name: Eleni Kounalakis
quote: As Treasurer, I will build more affordable housing through public finance
positionText: Supports using public financing to build affordable housing.

name: Fiona Ma
quote: As Lieutenant Governor, I will make higher education more affordable, expand paid internships, and strengthen career pathways.
positionText: Supports more affordable higher education, paid internships, and career pathways.

name: Gloria Romero
quote: I will restore education standards, develop a bold economic plan that helps businesses thrive
positionText: Supports restoring education standards and developing a business growth plan.

name: Donald P. (Don) Wagner
quote: As Secretary of State, I pledge to speed up vote counting, secure our elections, and remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics.
positionText: Supports faster vote counting and a nonpartisan chief elections officer.

name: Shirley N. Weber
quote: Every eligible Californian should register to vote and cast their ballot whether we agree politically or not.
positionText: Supports voter registration and participation for every eligible Californian.

name: Nelson Esparza
quote: Nelson will oppose new taxes on middle class and working class families as well as small businesses that are already struggling to make ends meet.
positionText: Opposes new taxes on working and middle-class families and struggling small businesses.

name: Shannon Grove
quote: To defend taxpayer protections like Proposition 13 that keep people in their homes.
positionText: Supports preserving Proposition 13 taxpayer protections.

name: Sally J. Lieber
quote: Over the next four years, I will continue to work for accurate and equitable property tax assessments, expanded taxpayer assistance, and policies that support housing affordability, rapid disaster recovery, and economic stability for working families.
positionText: Supports fair property assessments, taxpayer assistance, housing affordability, and disaster recovery.

name: John Pimentel
quote: I’ll fight to end sales tax on restaurant and delivered food that everyday people rely upon in their busy lives.
positionText: Supports ending sales tax on restaurant and delivered food.

name: John Pimentel
quote: I’ll fight to end loopholes so billionaires and corporations pay their taxes.
positionText: Supports closing tax loopholes used by billionaires and corporations.

name: Mike Gipson
quote: Mike will fight to close tax loopholes that wealthy insiders and powerful corporations exploit to avoid paying their fair share.
positionText: Supports closing tax loopholes used by wealthy individuals and corporations.

name: Denis Bilodeau
quote: I’ll oppose the proposed car mileage tax.
positionText: Opposes a car mileage tax.

name: Tom Umberg
quote: I will be your voice for tax fairness, protecting homeowners, renters, and small businesses while standing up to wealthy interests who get around the rules.
positionText: Supports tax fairness for homeowners, renters, and small businesses.

name: Richard Barrera
quote: As State Superintendent, Barrera will roll up his sleeves and work with the same energy and zeal to bring those reforms to every school in California.
positionText: Proposes extending his San Diego school reform approach statewide.

name: Sonja Shaw
quote: My plan is simple: restore high academic standards in reading, writing, and math; protect Title IX, ensuring fairness and safety for girls; cut wasteful bureaucracy; and demand fiscal transparency to ensure money reaches classrooms where it belongs, supporting our students and our great teachers.
positionText: Supports higher academic standards, Title IX protections for girls, reduced bureaucracy, and transparent school spending.

name: Dan Cox
quote: He plans to reduce the corporate and income tax rate to 4.9%.
positionText: Proposes reducing corporate and income tax rates to 4.9%.

name: Dan Cox
quote: He will pursue clean energy methods such as SMRs and LNGs, while preserving our farmlands and a clean Bay.
positionText: Supports small modular nuclear reactors and liquefied natural gas.

name: Dan Cox
quote: Dan Cox will use emergency order to begin the build for the Key Bridge immediately.
positionText: Proposes an emergency order to start rebuilding the Key Bridge.

name: Dan Cox
quote: A Dan Cox administration will prioritize ensuring that our schools are fully funded, that our teachers have the resources they need, and that every dollar is going straight to the classrooms and our children's education.
positionText: Supports full school funding and directing education spending to classrooms.

name: Andy Ellis
quote: Andy Ellis has a comprehensive policy to stop the data centers in Maryland.
positionText: Opposes data-center development in Maryland.

name: Andy Ellis
quote: Declare climate, environment, energy, food, and water emergencies to ensure state and local government act with urgency.
positionText: Proposes declaring climate, environmental, energy, food, and water emergencies.

name: Sonya Dunn
quote: As Comptroller, I will work every day to ensure Maryland's finances are managed responsibly and that taxpayers always come first.
positionText: Supports responsible management of Maryland's public finances.

name: Brooke Elizabeth Lierman
quote: We will take the Office of the Comptroller from our mainframe systems to the cloud – transforming the office into a modern efficient and effective resource for every Marylander, business, contractor, and non-profit.
positionText: Supports moving the Comptroller's computer systems to the cloud.

name: Sarah Elfreth
quote: Sarah believes everyone deserves access to affordable, quality health care.
positionText: Supports access to affordable, quality healthcare for everyone.

name: Sarah Elfreth
quote: she has proudly supported commonsense gun safety legislation to close loopholes, ensure proper background checks, and ban assault weapons.
positionText: Supports background checks and a ban on assault weapons.

name: Sarah Elfreth
quote: Sarah has proudly pushed for a ban on Congressional stock trading to ensure our elected officials are working in your best interest – not the interest of their stock portfolio.
positionText: Supports banning stock trading by members of Congress.

name: Sarah Elfreth
quote: Sarah is fighting for a clean energy future, tackling rising tides by helping our neighbors become more resilient to climate change, and expanding access to the Bay for generations to come.
positionText: Supports clean energy, climate resilience, and access to the Chesapeake Bay.

name: Robin Ficker
quote: In Congress, he will work to slash wasteful spending, reduce the federal deficit, and restore sanity to the budget process.
positionText: Supports reducing federal spending he considers wasteful and lowering the deficit.

name: Robin Ficker
quote: He will champion lower taxes, fewer regulations, and pro-growth policies that incentivize businesses to invest in our workforce and strengthen our economy right here in Maryland.
positionText: Supports lower taxes and fewer business regulations.

name: Robin Ficker
quote: Robin Ficker will support our police, hold criminals accountable, and fight against soft-on-crime policies that put families at risk.
positionText: Supports law enforcement and stricter criminal accountability.

name: Sam Husseini
quote: As your representative in Congress, I will vote to stop the privatization slide of Medicare and Medicaid and the threat to Social Security.
positionText: Opposes privatizing Medicare and Medicaid and supports protecting Social Security.

name: Sam Husseini
quote: We must rein in the surveillance and intimidation apparatus and stand up for our civil liberties.
positionText: Supports limiting government surveillance and protecting civil liberties.

name: Cheryl Riley
quote: In Congress, I will push for pro-growth business policies that protect American workers and put American businesses first.
positionText: Supports business growth policies prioritizing American businesses and workers.

name: Moshe Y. Landman
quote: Healthcare: Implement a universal healthcare system
positionText: Supports implementing universal healthcare.
